title: Cartwise+ Membership Fee Refund Terms by Plan
content:
The refund terms of the Cartwise+ Membership plans are set per plan as follows.

| Plan | Unused-refund window after a fee charge (calendar days) | Full refund requires no benefit used since the charge | Prorated refund of unused full months available | Prorated refund available while at most this many months have started | Duplicate charge refunded if reported within (calendar days) | Refund returned to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 7 | yes | no | 0 | 60 | the original payment method |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 7 | yes | no | 0 | 60 | the original payment method |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 7 | yes | no | 0 | 60 | the original payment method |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 14 | yes | yes | 9 | 60 | the original payment method |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | 14 | yes | yes | 9 | 60 | the original payment method |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 14 | yes | yes | 9 | 60 | the original payment method |

## Column meanings

- **Unused-refund window**: the number of calendar days after a period fee charge within which a full refund is available if no benefit was used.
- **Full refund requires no benefit used**: whether a full refund requires that no member benefit was used since the charge.
- **Prorated refund of unused full months**: whether a prorated refund of unused full months is available outside the full-refund window.
- **Months started**: a prorated refund is available only while at most this many months of the period have started; 0 appears on plans that have no prorated refund.
- **Duplicate charge window**: the number of calendar days after capture within which a duplicate period charge is refunded in full.
- **Refund returned to**: where a fee refund is returned; for every plan it is the original payment method rather than Cartwise credit.
